node.statement: Core-replacement estimate and sum: outside the union of the C_s, the corresponding row of (A-hatA)N is zero. If i is in C_s, that row is (a_i-e_s)N=sum_t a_{it}nu_t-nu_s, whose l1 norm is at most (1-a_{is})+sum_{t not equal s}a_{it}=2(1-a_{is})<2*lambda because every nu_t is a probability vector. Thus ||(A-hatA)N||_{infinity->infinity}<=2*lambda. Since AM-E=A(M-N)+(A-hatA)N, the triangle inequality gives ||AM-E||<=epsilon/lambda+2*lambda=2*sqrt(2*epsilon).
